meta.description: Find temples, beaches, waterfalls, parks and heritage sites near you in Sri Lanka, with practical info and directions.

common.unverifiedHint: We haven't confirmed these details on the ground yet. Check locally before you go.
common.offlineHint: Showing what we saved earlier. Some things won't load until you reconnect.

emergency.title: Emergency numbers
emergency.intro: Tap a number to call. These work from any phone in Sri Lanka.

states.emptyBody: Try a wider radius or a different category.
states.errorBody: We couldn't load this. Check your connection and try again.
states.notFoundBody: This road doesn't go anywhere. Head back to places near you.

design.title: Design system
design.intro: Roadside Ceylon: laterite earth, tea-country green, Indian Ocean teal and sun-bleached sand. Built for bright sun, small screens and slow connections.
design.coloursHint: Every text pair is checked against WCAG AA in both themes.
design.typographyHint: Young Serif for headings, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for everything you need to read quickly.
design.bodySample: The climb takes about an hour. Start before the heat, carry water, and keep your voice low near the hornet nests on the upper stairway.
design.kmPostHint: Styled after the white roadside kilometre posts found across the island.
design.placeholdersHint: Generated per category until real photos are approved.
design.contrastTable: Contrast ratios for every token pair

location.explainerBody: TukTrail sorts temples, beaches, waterfalls and more by how far they are from you.
location.explainerPrivacy: We only use your location to sort places. It's rounded to about 100 m, sent with each search, and never stored or logged.
location.pickOnMap: Pick a spot on the map
location.deniedBody: No problem. Choose a town or tap the map instead. You can allow location later in your browser settings.
location.unavailableBody: We couldn't get your location. Choose a town or tap the map instead.
location.pickModeHint: Tap the map to set your location

nearby.title: Places near you
nearby.count: {count, plural, =0 {No places} one {# place} other {# places}} within {km} km
nearby.countSearch: {count, plural, =0 {No matches} one {# match} other {# matches}} for “{q}”
nearby.emptyRadiusBody: Try a wider distance or fewer filters.
nearby.emptySearchBody: Check the spelling, or try a district name like “Kandy”.

map.label: Map of places
map.unavailableBody: The list still works. Check your connection to load the map.

place.bestMonthsHint: Highlighted months are usually the driest here. Weather varies year to year.
place.notListedBody: We only list fees and opening hours once someone has confirmed them on the ground. Please check locally before you go.
place.unverifiedBody: Everything on this page is based on general knowledge and hasn't been checked on the ground yet. Things change, so please confirm locally.

auth.intro: Sign in to share photos of places you've visited. We'll never post anything for you.
auth.checkEmailBody: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It works once and expires in 5 minutes.
auth.resendIn: You can send another link in {seconds}s
auth.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
auth.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
auth.failed: We couldn't send the link. Please try again.
auth.linkExpired: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Please request a new one.
auth.privacy: We only use your email to sign you in.

upload.ctaBody: Photos taken at the place help other travellers. They appear after a quick review.
upload.intro: Add up to {max} photos you took here. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB each.
upload.signInFirstBody: You need an account so we can show you when your photos are reviewed.
upload.selected: {count, plural, one {# photo selected} other {# photos selected}}
upload.tooMany: You can add up to {max} photos at a time.
upload.badType: {name} isn't a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
upload.captionHint: Describe what's in the photo. This helps people using screen readers.
upload.useLocation: Use my current location to confirm I'm here
upload.useLocationHint: Recommended if you're at the place now. Otherwise we check the location saved in your photos.
upload.exifHint: Tip: some apps remove location data when sharing photos. Upload the original from your camera roll.
upload.successBody: Your photos are waiting for a quick review. We'll show them on the place page once they're approved.
upload.outsideTitle: We couldn't confirm you were at {place}
upload.outsideBody: Photos need to be taken within {radius} of the place.
upload.outsideClosest: The closest location we found was about {distance} away.
upload.outsideNoData: Your photos don't contain location data, and we couldn't use your current location.
upload.outsideHelp: Try again while you're at the place with location turned on, or choose originals that still have their location data.
upload.locationDenied: Location wasn't available, so we'll check the location saved in your photos instead.
upload.rateLimited: You've shared a lot today. Please try again tomorrow.
upload.failed: Something went wrong while uploading. Please try again.
upload.uploadFailed: Photo {index} didn't upload. Check your connection and try again.

myUploads.title: My photos
myUploads.intro: Photos you've shared. New photos are reviewed before they appear publicly.
myUploads.empty: You haven't shared any photos yet
myUploads.emptyBody: Open a place you've visited and tap "Add photos".
myUploads.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this photo? This can't be undone.
myUploads.signInBody: Sign in to see the photos you've shared.
myUploads.removedFile: This photo was removed after review.

reasons.off_topic: It doesn't clearly show this place.
reasons.poor_quality: It's too blurry, dark or small to help other travellers.
reasons.people_privacy: It shows people's faces or other personal details up close.
reasons.duplicate: We already have a very similar photo.
reasons.not_own_photo: It looks like it wasn't taken by you.
reasons.inappropriate: It isn't suitable for a travel guide.

nav.label: Admin sections
nav.waiting: {count, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} waiting for review

overview.title: Overview
overview.heading: Hello, {name}
overview.intro: {decided, plural, =0 {No visitor photos were reviewed in the last 7 days.} one {# visitor photo was reviewed in the last 7 days.} other {# visitor photos were reviewed in the last 7 days.}}
overview.pendingPhotos: {count, plural, one {photo waiting for review} other {photos waiting for review}}
overview.pendingHint: Oldest first. Visitors see their photos once you approve them.
overview.unverified: {count, plural, one {place not yet verified} other {places not yet verified}}
overview.unverifiedHint: Details nobody has confirmed on the ground yet.

moderation.title: Photo review
moderation.intro: Visitor photos wait here until you approve them. Approving publishes the photo and records the visitor's visit. Either way, the location the photo was taken at is deleted.
moderation.emptyPendingBody: New visitor photos will appear here.
moderation.emptyDecidedBody: Photos you review will be listed here, newest first.
moderation.signedOut: Your session may have ended. Sign in again as an admin.
moderation.approvedHero: Photo of {place} approved and set as its main photo.
moderation.rejectedMsg: Photo not approved. The visitor will see: {reason}
moderation.alreadyReviewed: Someone has already reviewed this photo. Reload to see the latest.
moderation.actionFailed: That didn't work. Please try again.
moderation.caption: Caption
moderation.checkedDevice: Visit confirmed by the phone's location, {distance} from the place (allowed: within {radius}).
moderation.checkedExif: Visit confirmed by the photo's own location, {distance} from the place (allowed: within {radius}).
moderation.mapLabel: Map: {place} and where the photo was taken
moderation.firstPhoto: This place has no real photo yet. Approving this one makes it the main photo.
moderation.fileRemoved: The file was deleted after review.
moderation.noteRequired: Add a short note for the visitor.
moderation.noteHint: The visitor sees the reason and your note under My photos. Keep it kind.

places.title: Places
places.noneBody: Try a different name or clear the filters.
places.pendingPhotos: {count, plural, one {# photo to review} other {# photos to review}}

form.errorSummary: {count, plural, one {Please fix # thing} other {Please fix # things}} before saving
form.name: Name
form.slugHint: tuktrail.lk/places/{slug}. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Changing it breaks old links.
form.districtHint: The province is set from the district.
form.locationIntro: Put the pin where visitors arrive, such as the entrance or main viewpoint. The circle is the visit area: photos must be taken inside it.
form.mapLabel: Map for setting the place's location
form.mapHint: Drag the pin or tap the map to move it, or type coordinates below.
form.mapHintUnset: Tap the map where the place is, or type its coordinates below.
form.radiusHint: 50 to 50,000. Around 1,000 for a temple, more for a park.
form.shortHint: Shown on cards and in search results. {count}/{max} characters.
form.practicalIntro: Only fill these in once someone has confirmed them on the ground. Never guess fees, opening hours or phone numbers. Empty fields are simply hidden on the place page.
form.feeHint: Whole rupees. Leave empty if unknown; enter 0 only if entry is confirmed free.
form.howToGetThereHint: General route notes only: no fares, timetables or phone numbers.
form.bestMonthsHint: Usually the driest months here. Choose none if it's good year-round.

status.publishedHint: Visible to everyone in nearby results, search and its own page.

form.verifiedHint: Turn on only when someone has checked the practical details in person. Otherwise visitors see "Details not yet verified".

errors.name: Name: 2 to 120 characters.
errors.slug: Web address: lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens.
errors.slugTaken: Web address: another place already uses it.
errors.location: Location: set a point in Sri Lanka.
errors.visitRadiusM: Visit area: a whole number from 50 to 50,000 metres.
errors.feeForeignLkr: Foreign visitor fee: a whole number of rupees, or empty.
errors.feeLocalLkr: Resident fee: a whole number of rupees, or empty.
errors.openingHours: Opening hours: give both times (HH:MM) for each open day.
errors.dressCode: What to wear: up to 1,000 characters.
errors.howToGetThere: How to get there: up to 2,000 characters.
errors.signedOut: Couldn't save: your session may have ended. Sign in again.

editor.created: Place created. Add photos below, and publish it when it's ready.
editor.newIntro: New places start as drafts, so nobody sees them until you publish.
editor.dangerHint: Deletes the place and all its photos for good.
editor.dangerHintPublished: Deletes the place and all its photos for good. To hide it for now, set it to Draft instead.
editor.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}" and all its photos? This can't be undone.
editor.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete the place. Please try again.

images.title: {count, plural, =0 {Photos} other {Photos (#)}}
images.pending: {count, plural, one {# visitor photo to review} other {# visitor photos to review}}
images.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
images.addIntro: Published straight away. Location data is stripped. Use only your own photos or freely licensed ones (never NC or ND), and credit them.
images.file: Photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB)
images.altHint: What the photo shows, e.g. "The rock fortress from the water gardens".
images.attributionHint: The photographer, e.g. "Jane Perera / Wikimedia Commons".
images.badType: That file isn't a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
images.missingFields: Add a description (3+ characters) and a credit.
